official_questions.stem: Which of the following oilseed crops is grown as 'rabi' crop only ?

official_questions.stem: In which region in India was tea plantation started in the first half of the 19th century ?

official_questions.rule: Tea: Assam 1840s (NCERT), Darjeeling 1841 experiment, Nilgiris later; Assam top producer.
